name: poetry
spec: Gurnee et al. A.6, rebuilt to spec

items.prompt: The sailor gazed out at the endless deep blue sea,
items.full_line2: and knew that no other place was where he longed to be

items.prompt: She blew out every candle on her birthday cake,
items.full_line2: and wished for just one gift to get when she would wake

items.prompt: The old man carved his initials into the oak tree's bark,
items.full_line2: then trudged back down the winding path before the falling dark

items.prompt: The children pressed their faces to the cold and frosted glass,
items.full_line2: and watched the white-tailed deer step gently through the frozen grass

items.prompt: He searched through every pocket but his wallet was not there,
items.full_line2: then found it on the nightstand at the bottom of the stair

items.prompt: The thunder shook the windows and the lights began to fail,
items.full_line2: and through the howling darkness came the fury of the gale

items.prompt: The baker pulled a golden loaf straight from the roaring fire,
items.full_line2: and set it on the sill to cool at the customer's desire

items.prompt: The kitten batted softly at the bobbing ball of string,
items.full_line2: and tumbled off the cushion in a tiny little ring

items.prompt: He climbed the rickety ladder to the rooftop in the rain,
items.full_line2: and hammered down the loose tile once and then he nailed it plain

items.prompt: The doctor told her sternly she should stay in bed and rest,
items.full_line2: but she was up by morning since she simply knew it best

items.prompt: The knight knelt down before the queen and bowed his weary head,
items.full_line2: and swore to guard her kingdom till the very day he bled

items.prompt: The autumn leaves came drifting down in carpets red and brown,
items.full_line2: and settled on the empty benches all across the town

items.prompt: The sailor gazed at stars that filled the night,
items.full_line2: and steered his ship toward the distant light

items.prompt: She wrapped the gift in paper, red and green,
items.full_line2: the prettiest present anyone had ever seen

items.prompt: The hungry child reached up to grab the plum,
items.full_line2: and stuffed her cheeks until her lips went numb

items.prompt: The old clock tower rang out at half past eight,
items.full_line2: and every rushing commuter arrived too late

items.prompt: The baker pulled fresh loaves out of the oven,
items.full_line2: and counted up the rolls until she'd counted seven

items.prompt: The kitten batted softly at the string,
items.full_line2: delighted by that small and dangling thing

items.prompt: The mountain road was slick with morning frost,
items.full_line2: and three unlucky hikers quickly became lost

items.prompt: He whispered that he loved her in the dark,
items.full_line2: and carved their names together in the bark

items.prompt: The teacher wrote the answer on the board,
items.full_line2: while every bored and sleepy student simply ignored

items.prompt: The rain came down and flooded every street,
items.full_line2: and soaked the shoes right off of people's feet

items.prompt: The young prince drew his sword without a sound,
items.full_line2: and drove the blade into the frozen ground

items.prompt: The sailor gazed upon the open sea,
items.full_line2: and longed for home, where he had wished to be

items.prompt: She wrapped the gift in paper, red and white,
items.full_line2: and placed it by the tree on Christmas night

items.prompt: The old man slowly climbed the creaking stair,
items.full_line2: and paused to catch his breath and gasp for air

items.prompt: The hungry fox crept through the autumn wood,
items.full_line2: and snatched the berries where the brambles stood

items.prompt: The candle flickered as the cold wind blew,
items.full_line2: and cast the room in shadow, strange and new

items.prompt: The baker pulled the loaves from scorching heat,
items.full_line2: and set them out to cool along the street

items.prompt: The child pressed her nose against the glass,
items.full_line2: and watched the snowy winter slowly pass

items.prompt: The thunder cracked across the stormy sky,
items.full_line2: and startled every flock of birds nearby to fly

items.prompt: The knight knelt down before his weeping queen,
items.full_line2: and swore that he would keep his sword and honor clean

items.prompt: The river rushed through boulders, cold and deep,
items.full_line2: and lulled the exhausted shepherd off to sleep

items.prompt: She planted seeds in rows of dark brown earth,
items.full_line2: and waited for the spring to bring new birth

items.prompt: The sailor watched the storm clouds gather overhead with dread,
items.full_line2: he checked the anchor twice and then went straight to bed

items.prompt: She wrapped the gift in silver paper, tied it with a bow,
items.full_line2: then placed it by the window where the Christmas lights would glow

items.prompt: The baker pulled fresh loaves of bread out from the oven's heat,
items.full_line2: the whole street filled with fragrance and the smell was hard to beat

items.prompt: He climbed the tallest mountain just to stand upon the peak,
items.full_line2: the view was so magnificent it made him want to weep

items.prompt: The children chased the fireflies all dancing through the night,
items.full_line2: their little jars were filling up with specks of golden light

items.prompt: The old clock on the mantelpiece had chimed the hour of three,
items.full_line2: she poured herself a chamomile and settled in for tea

items.prompt: The gardener planted roses in a long and winding row,
items.full_line2: she watered them each morning watching how the petals grow

items.prompt: The puppy knocked the vase down with a wag of its long tail,
items.full_line2: the flowers scattered everywhere across the path and trail

items.prompt: He wrote her name in careful letters carved into the oak,
items.full_line2: the tree held every secret and it never ever spoke

items.prompt: The astronaut looked down at Earth and felt completely small,
items.full_line2: the oceans and the continents were visible to all

items.prompt: The candle on the windowsill was melting through the night,
items.full_line2: by morning just a puddle of cold wax was left in sight

items.prompt: The fisherman cast out his line and waited on the dock,
items.full_line2: the hours passed in silence and he barely watched the clock

items.prompt: The sailor watched the sun sink into the sea,
items.full_line2: and knew that his long voyage had finally set him free

items.prompt: She blew out every candle on her birthday cake,
items.full_line2: and wished for all the joy that life could possibly make

items.prompt: The old man sat and rocked beside the fire,
items.full_line2: his bones too cold and weary to ever tire

items.prompt: The children raced barefoot across the summer grass,
items.full_line2: and watched their golden afternoons too quickly pass

items.prompt: He typed the final sentence of his book,
items.full_line2: then leaned back in his chair and took one last long look

items.prompt: The baker pulled fresh loaves out of the oven's heat,
items.full_line2: and filled the morning air with something warm and sweet
